numa_policy: inherited only; numactl absent from the process PATH
diagnostic_metrics: pilot, worker affinity, direct/wrapper launch, internal kernel; excluded from primary inference

tune.interval: 95% existing seeded paired bootstrap; no cross-session pooling

aa_interpretation_rule: Invalid controls stop execution; if either valid interval excludes 1, interpret performance as unstable/inconclusive without rerunning controls or changing raw tuner outcome

negative_confirmation_branch.condition: completed reference recipe with no held-out confirmation
negative_confirmation_branch.interpretation: separate fresh reference confirmation; no additional candidate selection opportunity

failure_policy: retain all warmups, exclusions, failures, incomplete pairs and slow observations; no automatic retry, outlier deletion, budget extension or favorable-result stopping
unavailable: No authorized native target supplied. Null site/build/pilot fields must be observed and frozen before evaluation; proposed cases may change only under a separately labeled pre-evaluation site protocol.
distribution_provenance: Portable counterpart of the private R06 draft; fill hashes from the actual transferred sdist, inventory and installed wheel before freezing. Original checkpoint hashes remain in private historical records.
